description: Full brief: docs/agent-work/2026-11-11-home-stretch/BRIEF.md then section HS9 of docs/agent-work/2026-11-11-home-stretch/TASKS.md. Shared files (styles.css, App.tsx, Writer.tsx, editor/editor.css) are edited by region only and registered on no task.

handoff.text: See docs/agent-work/2026-11-11-home-stretch/REVIEW-2.md. 1) should-fix, reproduced: src/components/ProjectSidebar.tsx:248/264 falls back to the session-local localOrder (reset only on project.id change) when props.groupOrder is undefined. After restoring a version with no sidebarOrder, the sidebar still shows the old heading order while Read/export (project.order) put Manuscript first. Repro: add Part two+Alpha, snapshot, move Part two up, restore: sidebar Part two first, export Opening first. It persists after an edit until reload. Fix: when props.onGroupOrder is given, use only props.groupOrder (sidebarOrder: props.onGroupOrder ? props.groupOrder : localOrder), or reset localOrder when groupOrder changes; add a Playwright case (snapshot, move heading, restore, then assert sidebar order == export order). 2) low: ProjectSidebar.tsx:781-783 More is drawn left of split (order:-1) but tabbed after it; optional DOM reorder. 3) low: built-in restore-default only by typing the default name (dialog refuses empty); optional 'Restore default name' item. 4) low, mostly pre-existing: styles.css:2112 (and :714) pad the whole .entry-main incl. .entry-preview, so hovering a card with body text re-wraps it and moves the cards below by 18px; pad the title span instead (probed: zero shifts). The hs9 spec's no-shift case uses empty cards. Everything else checked fine: normalisation, orphans, delete, drag, search, spy, tints, tests.
